_comment: Source of truth for the USA community guidelines table (legal/build.py) and a seed reference for the category_policy table. Default policy from brief Section 3.1; a US lawyer must confirm it before launch. Anything uncertain starts as blocked.

categories.licence: State-licensed insurance producer (agent or broker) whose licence is valid in the buyer's state, checked against the NIPR producer database.
categories.disclaimer: Insurance quotes are provided by independently licensed insurance producers, not by {{COMPANY_NAME}}. {{COMPANY_NAME}} is not an insurance agency or producer and does not sell, solicit or negotiate insurance. Coverage, eligibility and prices are determined by the insurer. Producer licence number: <shown on each quote>.

categories.licence: Not available (state lending licences and federal consumer credit rules).
Real estate broker or salesperson licence issued by the state where the property is located.
categories.disclaimer: Real estate services are provided by independently licensed brokers and agents. All listings and quotes are subject to the federal Fair Housing Act: we do not allow any preference, limitation or discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status or national origin, or any other class protected by state or local law.

categories.licence: Attorney with active admission to the bar of the state whose law governs the matter; bar number and state shown on the profile.
categories.disclaimer: ATTORNEY ADVERTISING. Quotes are provided by independent attorneys, not by {{COMPANY_NAME}}, which is not a law firm, does not provide legal advice and does not refer or recommend lawyers. Sending a request or receiving a quote does not create an attorney-client relationship. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.

categories.licence: Provider licensed by the relevant state board for the services quoted. No telehealth prescribing and no prescriptions through the app.
categories.disclaimer: {{APP_NAME}} does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment and is not a healthcare provider. Do not share detailed health information in requests or chat. In an emergency call 911.

categories.category: Firearms, ammunition, weapons and weapon parts

categories.licence: Contractor licence where the buyer's state (or locality) requires one for the job; licence number, classification and expiry shown on the quote.
categories.disclaimer: Licensing requirements vary by state and job size. Check the contractor's licence with your state licensing board before work starts. Permits may be required.

categories.licence: Interstate movers must show a valid USDOT number (and FMCSA MC number where required); intrastate rules vary by state.
categories.disclaimer: Interstate moves are regulated by FMCSA. Ask for the mover's USDOT number and the "Your Rights and Responsibilities When You Move" booklet.

categories.licence: Dealer licence number optional (shown if provided). Private sellers must disclose known defects and title status.
categories.disclaimer: Check the vehicle history and title before you pay. Used vehicles sold by dealers must display the FTC Buyers Guide.

categories.category: Everyday goods (appliances, electronics, furniture) and home services
categories.licence: None beyond seller verification (EIN or state business licence).
categories.disclaimer: Sales tax may apply. Prices are set by the seller.
